name: Redi-Meal Mealworms - Bird Food
description: During bitterly cold winters and springtime's breeding season, birds need rich sources of energy, protein, fat, and potassium. These mealworms are excellent sources of all four, and are a favorite among wrens, nuthatches and woodpeckers, who love filling their diet with insects. Protein-rich and easy to eat, birds will love feeding on the mealworms from your favorite bird feeder, whether hopper, tube, or platform. Add to your favorite seed mix or offer alone and watch birds flock to your garden. The dried mealworms, which come 2,000 to a bag, are easy to use and will keep for up to a year in a cool, dry place.
